blurb: Guests learn paragliding equipment, ground handling, basic ground school, weather, and may take their first solo flight. Certification courses progress through ground school and flight training to become a USHPA certified P2 pilot. The school offers advanced clinics like SIV for skill development and confidence.
extraNote: Deposit for Introductory Class is full fee; deposit for Beginner/Novice Course is $700 per certification · Deposits refundable only if qualified replacement student found · No refunds or exchanges for students who terminate programs · Programs not transferable to another individual · Surcharge may apply if student misses training for more than 12 weeks · If unable to complete program due to operational shutdown, pro-rated refund or merchandise exchange
